name: Lot 7: Last Words of the Bright Lanterns

description.value:
“Last words of the Bright Lanterns. Very sad. Very long.” (Open 2, rival max 4)

The final recording of the last adventuring party. It runs three hours. Its last ten minutes show four exhausted adventurers crawling through a maintenance duct behind the Showroom's seventh plinth, reaching a hatch into the Core Vault before a drone finds them.

  • The crawlway route into the Core Vault, which lets the party skip the vault door in the finale.
  • A cache in the duct: 3 applause injectors and a scroll of @UUID[Compendium.pf1.spells.Item.e5kw4dwf9qwty6tl]{greater dispel magic}.
  • The Lanterns' leader whispering, “She's not in the Booth. The Booth is a doll. She's down.”

Celmak never watched past hour one. When she realises what she sold, she drops the ratings by 1.
